dedupe_keys.name: pl swat simulated polish water balance and streamflow

description: The Warsaw University of Life Sciences research team publishes PL-SWAT-51_20 through 4TU.ResearchData. SWAT simulations describe daily water-balance components and streamflow across Poland and upstream transboundary catchments from 1951 to 2020. The spatial units include 4,381 subbasins and river reaches; supporting geometry is available as shapefiles and KML, with time series in NetCDF. The repository provides the files free under CC0. Calibration and validation used 88 gauges during 2000–2019, with repository median Kling–Gupta efficiencies of 0.73 and 0.69. These are model outputs, not direct observations, and performance varies by catchment. They can supply river inflows and water-availability scenarios for reservoir, water-supply and flood simulations. They complement data-hydrosheds-hydrorivers-hydrobasins with a calibrated historical Polish hydrological simulation. File contents and model execution were not checked.
